representative_scale.scale_selection: One fixed scale specified by brief; no scale search.

inputs.coordinates: Published equilibrated PDB, unchanged for each replica.

energy_series.availability: Driver samples energies internally but emits only mean and final value; full series output unavailable without later instrumentation.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter starts after PDB/force-field/system/platform preparation, before first context/integrator creation; ends after last context/integrator deletion. Includes context creation/kernel compilation, velocity initialization, stepping, energy queries, and context destruction. Excludes installation, input parsing, shared system creation and final JSON write.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after positions/velocities initialized; covers integration and energy sampling, excludes context construction and destruction.
timing_scope.concurrent: Measure elapsed time to finish all eight replicas on same one GPU with equivalent ensemble boundaries; concurrent driver and its timing implementation not supplied.

scoring_interface.acceptance_reason: No published fixed-work numerical acceptance tolerance; deterministic trajectory prediction remains unverified.
scoring_interface.evaluator_command_reason: No executable scoring/evaluation command published in brief.

runtime_evidence.claim: Approximately one minute on H100, a few minutes on slower GPUs, unverified for CUDA.
runtime_evidence.budget_fit: Expected to fit default method_run budget based on brief; no measured guarantee.

unavailable.mps_driver_command: Brief supplies hypothesis and public fixed-time study command, but no fixed-work concurrent launch script.
unavailable.gate_scripts: No gate script paths or commands supplied; JSON structure and consistency checked during intake.
